purpose: Advance CP10 group-scale source acquisition without opening object, thermodynamic, stellar-baryon, inferred-mass, or lensing rows. Prefer X-GAP, freeze one clean authoritative replacement catalogue ReadMe only after X-GAP's advertised master attachment remains unavailable, and keep bridge authorization closed.

fact_provenance_contract.claim_limit: The audit records authoritative locations checked by the cutoff. Search incompleteness and mutable remote content prevent a universal claim that no other release exists.

No current official retrievable X-GAP alias file was located in the checked publisher, CDS/VizieR, Zenodo, Yareta, or ESA programme metadata. The official CDS AXES-2MRS ReadMe was therefore frozen as a replacement catalogue manifest only.

axes2mrs.reason: The ReadMe exposes only the schema. Its released table has IDs and coordinates but no direct M500 field, and no scientific rows may be opened in this acquisition.

procedure: Freeze official X-GAP or replacement aliases and the canonical X-COP aliases before any response values are opened.
Normalize Unicode to NFKD, uppercase, remove whitespace and punctuation, and apply only a preregistered catalogue-prefix synonym map.
Exclude an overlap only on an exact normalized alias or an exact numeric identifier within the same documented catalogue namespace.

Do not auto-match on sky position because X-ray centroids, optical group centers, and BCG coordinates can differ; unresolved positional candidates block split publication until an authoritative cross-identification is frozen.
Resolve one-to-many or many-to-one aliases before whole-group split assignment; never use thermodynamic, inferred-mass, lensing, or candidate-score values to adjudicate identity.
xcop_overlap_contract.blocker: No retrievable X-GAP alias inventory and no opened AXES-2MRS object rows; overlap cannot be computed honestly.

endpoint_and_covariance_state.reason: The only frozen file is a CDS schema manifest. The unopen global catalogue does not advertise these endpoint or covariance products, and no X-GAP full-sample derived-product release was located.

license_and_redistribution_state.rule: Article or service accessibility is not treated as a per-file scientific-data redistribution license. Obtain and bind explicit catalogue/product terms before redistribution or payload commitment.
